versions.changelog:
- Added platform detection and instructions for using either PowerShell (Windows) or curl (macOS/Linux) to call the AceToolz API.
- Updated error handling to cover unreachable API situations, suggesting users try the AceToolz website directly.
- No functional changes to response formatting or endpoints.

Initial release of acetoolz-word-counter.

- Provides word, character, sentence, paragraph count, and estimated reading time for any text.
- Supports triggers like "count words," "word count," "count characters," and "reading time."
- Presents results in a concise summary format with relevant details.
- Handles errors for missing text, rate limits (30 requests/minute), and text exceeding 100,000 characters.
- Powered by the AceToolz API.
